en_title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2.5 Brawler Reportedly in Development From CD Projekt and Shantae Studio WayForward
cn_title: 传《赛博朋克：边缘行者》2.5D游戏开发中
subtitle: 代号双子星
opus_summary: 据MP1st报道，WayForward自2025年起开发代号「Gemini」的《赛博朋克：边缘行者》2.5D清版动作游戏，项目仍处研究设计阶段，是否延续尚不明朗。第二季计划今秋在Netflix首播。

pending_dict.note: 动画作品名；正文与标题实际使用。
续作暂称；正文实际使用。
系列续作名；正文实际使用。

paragraphs.en: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is being turned into a 2.5D brawler by Shantae developer WayForward, it's been reported.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，《赛博朋克：边缘行者》正由《Shantae》开发商WayForward改编为一款2.5D清版动作游戏。

paragraphs.en: Edgerunners, the acclaimed anime spin-off from CD Projekt's Cyberpunk 2077, is set to return soon for more episodes — but there's even more from its world on the way. That's according to a report by MP1st , which has lifted the lid on an unannounced project codenamed "Gemini" that has been in development since 2025.
paragraphs.cn: 广受好评的动画衍生作《赛博朋克：边缘行者》改编自CD Projekt的《赛博朋克2077》，不久后将带来更多集数；不过，其世界观下还有更多内容正在路上。据MP1st报道，一项自2025年起开发、代号为「Gemini」的未公布项目已被曝光。

paragraphs.en: Details gleaned from an unnamed former WayForward employee point to the project being in the research and design phase — so still some way from launching. Still, the game has apparently been planned as a "rollback-driven" 2.5D brawler, potentially similar to WayForward's River City Girls series — which also has an anime vibe.
paragraphs.cn: 从一名未具名的前WayForward员工处获得的细节显示，该项目正处于研究与设计阶段，距离推出仍有一段路。不过据称，这款游戏计划做成一款「采用回滚机制」的2.5D清版动作游戏，可能类似同样带有动画风格的WayForward《River City Girls》系列。

paragraphs.en: What's unclear now is whether the project remains in development. MP1st reports that WayForward had an unannounced game based on an external franchise cancelled last year after losing funding, leading to layoffs last September — but it's unknown if this project was Gemini, or something else.
paragraphs.cn: 目前尚不清楚该项目是否仍在开发。MP1st报道称，WayForward有一款基于外部IP、尚未公布的游戏在去年失去资金后被取消，并在去年9月引发裁员；但尚不确定该项目究竟是Gemini，还是其他项目。

paragraphs.en: CD Projekt declined to comment on the matter when contacted by IGN today.
paragraphs.cn: IGN今日就此事联系CD Projekt时，对方拒绝置评。

paragraphs.en: And, of course, even if Gemini does not ultimately see a release, Cyberpunk fans can look forward to a second season of Edgerunners — which is currently set to premiere on Netflix this fall. Fans have already been analyzing a recent trailer to try and work out where the new episodes will be set . You can also read about how Season 1 nearly had an even sadder ending than the one it got.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，即便Gemini最终未能发售，《赛博朋克》粉丝仍可期待《赛博朋克：边缘行者》第二季，该季目前计划于今年秋季在Netflix首播。粉丝已经在分析最近发布的预告片，试图弄清新集数将以何处为舞台。你还可以了解第一季原本差点采用一个比最终版本更悲伤的结局。

paragraphs.en: On the video game front, Cyberpunk 2 is in development, with 163 people working on it as of the end of April. While we know little about the sequel, Cyberpunk creator Mike Pondsmith teased some details when he was asked about the scope of his involvement with what was then known as Project Orion, back at the Digital Dragons 2025 conference.
paragraphs.cn: 游戏方面，《赛博朋克2》正在开发中，截至4月底已有163人参与该项目。我们对这部续作所知不多；不过在2025年Digital Dragons大会上，当《赛博朋克》创始人Mike Pondsmith被问及他参与当时仍名为Project Orion的项目到何种程度时，他曾透露了一些细节。

paragraphs.en: In September last year, speaking with IGN while promoting his movie Good Fortune, Keanu Reeves said that he wanted to be part of the Cyberpunk sequel . “Absolutely. I’d love to play Johnny Silverhand again," Reeves said when asked if he’d be interested in revisiting his legendary rockstar terrorist character in Cyberpunk 2. Pondsmith later said , and has told the much-loved actor: “contact me.”
paragraphs.cn: 去年9月，Keanu Reeves在宣传电影《Good Fortune》时接受IGN采访表示，他希望参与《赛博朋克》续作。「当然愿意。我很想再次饰演Johnny Silverhand，」当被问及是否有意在《赛博朋克2》中再度扮演这位传奇摇滚恐怖分子角色时，Reeves如此回答。Pondsmith后来也表示，并已对这位备受喜爱的演员说：「联系我。」

paragraphs.en: It sounds like we'll have to wait some time to find out. CD Projekt is of course focusing on The Witcher 4, and Nowakowski has suggested Cyberpunk 2 won’t be out until at least 2030. Perhaps that's why Cyberpunk 2077 fans have called on CD Projekt to change its mind and release more DLC for the game , as it is with The Witcher 3.
paragraphs.cn: 看来我们还得等上一段时间才能得知答案。CD Projekt当然正专注于《巫师4》，而Nowakowski曾暗示《赛博朋克2》至少要到2030年才会推出。或许正因如此，《赛博朋克2077》粉丝呼吁CD Projekt改变主意，像对《巫师3》那样为这款游戏推出更多DLC。
